annotations.title: Upload media into your Soclo library

description: Upload media from a public https:// URL into your Soclo Library for use with soclo_post_publish. Pass url, optional filename and contentType (image/* or video/*); Soclo fetches, validates and stores the file and returns the owned assetId (also searchable via soclo_library_search). Pass a stable requestId so retries return the same asset without uploading twice; reusing a requestId with different content is refused, a failed attempt replays its named error (use a new requestId to try again), and re-uploading the same URL reuses the existing copy. Refuses non-https URLs, IP literals, localhost, private/internal networks (including redirects), files over 50 MB, and bytes that do not match the declared image/* or video/* contentType. Needs publish:post.

contentType.description: Must be image/… or video/…, e.g. image/jpeg or video/mp4, and must match the file’s real bytes.

requestId.description: Stable id for this exact upload. REUSE it on a retry so the media is never uploaded twice. Omit to have Soclo derive one from the source.

url.description: A public https:// URL to the media file.
